items.source: Note: This ViewResolver implements the Ordered interface in order to allow for flexible participation in ViewResolver chaining. For example, some special views could be defined via this ViewResolver (giving it 0 as "order" value), while all remaining views could be resolved by a UrlBasedViewResolver.
items.translation: 注意：此 `ViewResolver` 实现了Ordered接口，以便灵活地参与 `ViewResolver` 链式处理。例如，可以通过此 `ViewResolver` 定义一些特殊视图（将其“order"值设为 0），而所有其余视图则由一个UrlBasedViewResolver解析。

items.source: Note: To allow for ViewResolver chaining, a ViewResolver should return null if a view with the given name is not defined in it. However, this is not required: Some ViewResolvers will always attempt to build View objects with the given name, unable to return null (rather throwing an exception when View creation failed).
items.translation: 注意：为了支持 ViewResolver 链式调用，如果未定义具有给定名称的视图，ViewResolver 应返回 `null`。然而，这并非必需：某些 ViewResolver 将始终尝试使用给定名称构建 View 对象，无法返回 `null`（而是在视图创建失败时抛出异常）。

items.source: The default value is Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE, meaning non-ordered.
Higher values are interpreted as lower priority. As a consequence, the object with the lowest value has the highest priority (somewhat analogous to Servlet load-on-startup values).
items.translation: 较高的值被解释为较低的优先级。因此，具有最低值的对象具有最高的优先级（类似于 Servlet 的 `load-on-startup` 值）。

items.source:
Same order values will result in arbitrary sort positions for the
affected objects.
items.translation: 相同的顺序值将导致受影响的对象具有任意的排序位置。

items.source: Get the order value of this object.
Resolve the given view by name.
items.translation: 按名称解析给定的视图。

items.source: Specify the order value for this ViewResolver bean.
items.translation: 为此 ViewResolver Bean 指定顺序值。
`getOrder` 接口 `Ordered` 中
`resolveViewName` 接口 `ViewResolver` 中

items.source: viewName - name of the view to resolve
locale - the Locale in which to resolve the view. ViewResolvers that support internationalization should respect this.
items.translation: locale - 解析视图的 Locale。支持国际化的 ViewResolvers 应尊重此设置。

items.source: the View object, or null if not found (optional, to allow for ViewResolver chaining)
items.translation: View 对象，如果未找到则为null （可选，以允许 ViewResolver 链式调用）
